name: Latticework
description: A diagonal lattice in two inks, one lean in front of the other.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 28%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 28%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 28%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 28%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
